name: Studio Composition Runtime
purpose: Canonical, dependency-free (GSAP 3.12.5 core only) runtime for HyperFrames compositions: format-aware layout variables, seeded randomness, path drawing and morphing, text splitting and typography motion, masks and scene transitions, depth/parallax, rhythm helpers, textures, reusable compositions and five style systems. Projects vendor a locked copy under src/_studio/.
capabilities: studio-core.js: format, safe areas, seeded rng/noise, timeline registration, scene show/hide/crossfade/cut
studio-draw.js: stroke draw, line art, hand-drawn lines, blobs, waves, morph, wobble, particles
studio-type.js: accessible split, mask rise, cascade, tracking, weight, typewriter, highlight, underline, counters
studio-motion.js: reveal/wipe/iris/push/shape-cover/liquid/match-cut transitions, depth camera, assembly, rhythm grid, grain
studio-compositions.js: title card, item list, step header, end card, captions
studio-base.css + styles/*.css: tokens, type scale per format, layout primitives, style systems

installation.instructions: python3 scripts/studio.py sync <slug> copies it into projects/<slug>/src/_studio/ with studio.lock.json.

compatibility.notes: Self-test (tests/test-studio-runtime.py) passes in Playwright Chromium on Windows: determinism, backward seeking and seek-order independence. Not yet rendered through HyperFrames.

licensing.notes: Original workspace code; no third-party code copied. GSAP is loaded separately (see library record).

security.notes: Runs inside the render browser only; no network calls of its own.

approval_evidence: tests/test-studio-runtime.py PASS; masala-chai-recipe frame review PASS in three formats (2026-10-30). Promote after HyperFrames renders on the M2 host.
